---
title: "Image viewer"
---

`askr-html` enables Quarto's native Lightbox automatically. Click an independent
image or figure to see it in a floating viewer, including its caption, while
remaining on the article. No separate image package or CDN is added.

## Images and opt-outs

```markdown
![Layout](images/layout.png){#fig-layout}
```

Inline images and images that already have a link keep Quarto's normal
treatment. Exclude an individual image with the native class:

```markdown
![Layout](images/layout.png){.nolightbox}
```

Disable automatic floating image viewing for a whole page in its YAML header:

```yaml
lightbox: false
```

Do not put `askr-image-view` buttons on a page with `lightbox: false`. Rendering
reports that conflict rather than producing a button that cannot work.

## Open an existing figure with a button

```markdown
![Layout](images/layout.png){#fig-layout}

{{{< askr-image-view target="fig-layout" label="View image" >}}}
```

Use the ID without `#`. The button reuses the figure's original image and
caption. The target must exist on this page and be an independent Lightbox
image, not an inline image, linked image, or `.nolightbox` exclusion. Invalid
targets fail during rendering.

## Show only a button

```markdown
{{{< askr-image-view src="images/layout.png" label="View image" >}}}
```

This registers a hidden native image and opens the same Quarto viewer. Image
paths resolve relative to the document, just like a normal Markdown image.
Specify exactly one of `target` or `src`; `label` defaults to `View image`.
Only `target` reuses an existing caption. The button-only form has no caption.

For non-HTML output, native images remain native images and the entries become
ordinary image/figure links, not interactive browser buttons.

## Galleries and viewing controls

Use Quarto's native `group` image attribute for a gallery:

```markdown
![First layout](images/first.png){group="layouts"}

![Second layout](images/second.png){group="layouts"}
```

In a gallery, use the previous/next controls or keyboard arrow keys. Close
with the close control or Escape to return to the original reading position
and focus entry. On a touchscreen, native swipe and pinch gestures are
available. On a desktop, click an image to zoom when its source dimensions
allow it, then drag the enlarged image; click again to restore its size.
There is no additional zoom toolbar. Small source images do not become sharper
by being enlarged, and failed image loads remain native viewer failures.

Try the real [Figures examples](../components/figures.qmd#image-viewer). See
[Quarto Lightbox figures](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-lightbox-figures.html)
for native options, captions, and computational-image settings.
